items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I know my grandmother… if somebody was sick she would say, “Go take Ms. Jones this [unintelligible} and this soup over there”.

ctx.x: I know my grandmother… if somebody was sick she would say, “Go take Ms. Jones this [unintelligible} and this soup over there”. And they would also tell on the kids if you were doing something wrong. Anybody could correct you and then they‟d tell your family about it.
Well you and Mona have certainly carried on that tradition out here in St. Albans.
